name: Aero Tech Manufacturing, Inc.
old_description: Aero Tech is an employee-owned manufacturer of truck mounts, precision sheet metal fabrication, and radiant ceiling panels engineered and built in-house for quality, control, and long-term performance.
about:
Aero Tech Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1967 in North Salt Lake, Utah. The company operates as an employee-owned business, a structure that the leadership says aligns accountability with day-to-day production decisions. It began as a precision sheet metal fabrication shop and has since expanded into multiple product lines.

Today the 84,000-square-foot facility houses custom sheet metal fabrication, powder coating and finishing, UL 508-listed industrial control panel assembly, electrical and pneumatic system integration, and electromechanical assembly. The shop supports both prototyping and full production runs, delivering components for truck mounts, radiant ceiling panels, and a range of industrial sub-assemblies.

The company serves customers in cleaning and restoration, aerospace and defense, medical and laboratory, industrial manufacturing, water and filtration systems, and material handling and automation. Professional cleaning contractors rely on its truck mount systems, while OEMs in aerospace and medical device sectors source precision sheet metal components and value-added assemblies.

Aero Tech emphasizes in-house control, with engineering, fabrication, and assembly under one roof to manage quality, timelines, and outcomes. The firm highlights its ISO 9001 certification, a five-stage cleaning and phosphate pretreatment system for coatings, and real-time project tracking as factors that differentiate its service.
